purpose: Controlled diagnostic replay of three first-physics-step outliers, preserving baseline and treating contact interventions only as counterfactuals

cases.baseline: Exact saved world root/joint states and first action in three environments; hold action, no resets or PPO. Original contact parameters unchanged. Scene size differs from8192; first-step equivalence explicitly measured.
cases.no_self_collision: Same three saved states/actions; enabled_self_collisions=false is a diagnostic intervention only, not adopted for training.
cases.no_floor: Same three saved states/actions and self-collisions enabled; terrain omitted as a diagnostic intervention only, not adopted for training.
